chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid narrated to me from someone whose name he mentioned, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Sa'dan ibn Muslim, from 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One of you goes out to the graves and offers salutation, saying: 'Peace be upon the people of the graves, peace be upon those who are in them from among the believers and the Muslims. You have preceded us and we are following you, and indeed we shall join you. And indeed we are Allah's and indeed to Him we shall return. O people of the graves, after having dwelt in palaces! O people of the graves, after having enjoyed blessings and joy! You have gone to the graves. O people of the graves, how did you find the taste of death?' Then he says: 'Woe to whoever has gone to the Fire.' Then he sheds his tears and departs.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and etiquette when visiting the graves in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* outlines the ritual salutation for visiting the graves of believers, emphasizing the concept of *furatiyyah* (the deceased as pioneers for the living). It highlights the Shia practice of addressing the dead directly to reflect on mortality and the transient nature of worldly pleasures, concluding with a supplication for the Hereafter.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 17. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan ibn Walīd narrated to me from someone whose name he mentioned, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh Al-Barqi, from his father, from Sa’dān ibn Muslim, from ‘Ali ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Basīr, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: When you go to the graves, say Salām and recite (the following):

Salām upon the people of the graves. Salām upon the believers and the Muslims in the graves. You have preceded us and we shall follow you and (soon) we will join you. Verily we are Allāh’s and to Him we shall return. O those who are in graves after having lived in palaces! O those who are in graves after having enjoyed the blessings and the pleasures! O people of the graves! Now that you are in the graves, how did you find the taste of death?!!! Then say, “Woe unto those who have gone to Hell.” And then cry and leave.
